top_comments.body: Have had a similar issue the past 14 hours on Claude Code on Windows, run both from VS Code and Command line. Tried removing all cached files, restarting, updating Claude.. no fixes yet.    Practically unusable as it starts to become unresponsive (for up to 20 minutes at a time) when working on tasks - it kicks in at very early stages too - long before any auto-compact.   Larger scripts obviously more problematic.
